purpose: Select a registered nested worktree continuation from its exact authenticated live checkout claim when the persisted selected-checkout projection still names the repository root.

authorization.basis: Active Control campaign claim claim:mncs-control-mcp:worktree:09711c2d8fda for the exact registered checkout and branch.

behavior: A snapshot match against the validated Git checkout remains sufficient.

A stale snapshot may match only through an active worktree-scoped claim for the same repository, canonical checkout path, and branch; available checkout and common-directory identities must also agree.
A repository-wide claim does not identify a nested checkout.
Distinct registered worktrees remain independently selectable.
Two active sessions claiming the exact same checkout remain ambiguous.

readiness.direct_nested_checkout_selection: verified by unit regression for exact authenticated claim evidence

limitations: This change does not create, transfer, or expand claims; claims are consumed as read-only authenticated continuation evidence.
The live Environment gateway and canonical checkpoint are validated after merge and push.
